page: City page: B2B lead generation Dubai (/b2b-lead-generation-dubai)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Dubai?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Dubai companies work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our clients in other cities do. This page describes the Dubai market we serve, not a local branch.

items.question: What should I look for in a lead generation company in Dubai?
items.answer: Four things: lists built from buying signals instead of bought databases, dedicated sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, copy written for your specific buyer, and reporting that shows every reply and meeting. Ask who writes the copy and who you will speak to each week before you sign.

items.question: Which UAE businesses is this built for?
items.answer: IT, SaaS and managed service providers; distributors, trading houses and B2B service firms in facilities, logistics, insurance and recruitment; and Indian and international companies that want UAE clients or partners. Related work includes 16 managed IT meetings and 20 employee benefits meetings in the UAE. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in the UAE. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending infrastructure so your main domain is never at risk, write copy that reads as native to UAE buyers and send in their working hours. Our UAE campaigns include managed IT services, employee benefits insurance, commercial kitchen equipment distributors and pharma distribution partners.

items.question: Can you reach buyers elsewhere in the GCC?
items.answer: Yes. The same system can target buyers in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman and the rest of the GCC, with lists, copy and sending set up for each market. We usually recommend starting with one market and adding the next once the first is booking meetings.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an SDR in Dubai means recruiting, a visa and months of ramp-up before they are fully productive, and one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.
